---
title: "Preface"
---

These notes accompany BIOS 20153 Fundamentals of Ecology and Evolutionary Biology at the University of Chicago.

## How to use these notes

The notes are the primary reference for the course. They cover all material needed for the exams. Where the notes and the lectures differ, the notes take precedence.

## Prerequisites

A working knowledge of single-variable calculus (derivatives, integrals, differential equations). No prior background in ecology or evolutionary biology is assumed.

## Notation

A summary of notation conventions used throughout:

| Symbol | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| $n$ | population size or sample size |
| $t$ | time |
| $r$ | intrinsic growth rate |
| $K$ | carrying capacity |

Full notation conventions are introduced as needed in each chapter.
